en: Vintage divided-back postcard with three black‑and‑white views of military buildings labeled in German: the officers' mess, the barracks, and the canteen. The captions include the place name Hermannstadt. The reverse has Hungarian postal text (Levelező‑lap) and a green 5 filler Hungarian stamp postmarked around 1914, addressed within Hungary. Printer credit reads Jos. Drotleff, Hermannstadt.
